final: SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS BytesPerMillisecond, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) / (SELECT AVG(MediaTypeRate) FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(t2.Bytes AS REAL) / t2.Milliseconds) AS MediaTypeRate FROM MediaType m2 JOIN Track t2 ON t2.MediaTypeId = m2.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m2.MediaTypeId)) AS RelativeToSimpleAverage FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
